source_seasons.source: fotmob team stats + jobsinfootball PPDA analysis
fotmob team stats + totalfootballanalysis PPDA analysis

possession_pct.notes: Averaged from 50.5% and 50.6% across the two most recent Bournemouth seasons. Notably NOT a possession-dominant identity -- Liverpool ran 60-62% last season, so this is a meaningful expected shift toward a more balanced/direct approach.

ppda.unit: opposition passes allowed per defensive action
ppda.notes: ~9.9 in 2024/25 (best in Premier League), ~9.0-10.5 in 2025/26 depending on point in season. Elite, extreme pressing identity, consistent across both seasons -- this is Iraola's clearest signature metric.

shots_on_target_per_match.notes: 4.5 and 4.6 across the two most recent seasons -- stable.

goals_conceded_per_match.notes: 1.6 (2025/26 partial-season snapshot) vs 1.2 (2024/25). Wide variance intentionally set higher here since these two figures disagree more than other metrics -- reflects real uncertainty.

accurate_passes_per_match.notes: 342.8 and 339.7 -- consistent with the ~50% possession figure, i.e. moderate, not possession-monopoly buildup volume.

accurate_crosses_per_match.notes: Low relative to league (ranked 17th-19th both seasons) -- supports the 'through the middle, not width-and-crosses' read.

formation_prior.notes: 4-2-3-1 was the clear base across all three Bournemouth seasons. Briefly experimented with 4-1-4-1 for the first two matches of 2025/26 before reverting. Alpha counts are illustrative pseudo-weights, not literal match counts -- calibrated so 4-2-3-1 dominates but isn't treated as absolute certainty.

2023/24.source: fotmob team stats, cross-checked against season attendance figure to confirm full-season (not partial) snapshot

2024/25.note: FotMob search snippets returned partial-season snapshots that couldn't be reliably distinguished from final totals. Qualitative source (fantasyfootballscout) confirms Bournemouth ranked 5th in the league for xG this season, but no clean numeric total was verifiable. football-data.org confirmed NOT viable (live-tested 2026-08-09: fixtures/results/odds only, no xG field at any tier). Direct-fetch retry against FotMob/FBref/footystats (2026-08-09) also failed: FotMob's stats pages are client-rendered JS (fetch returns 'stats not available'), FBref and footystats both return HTTP 403 (bot-blocked, consistent with the block CLAUDE.md already documents). Remains a genuine gap -- needs either a paid tactical-stats API or a manual pull from a logged-in browser session.

2025/26.note: Same issue as 2024/25. One WebFetch against a guessed FotMob season-stats URL returned 61.9, but the page's own text described the season as 'still underway' -- inconsistent with 2025/26 having already concluded by the current date (2026-08-09), so this number is not trustworthy and was NOT recorded. Flagged as a known gap rather than guessed.

style_notes: Direct, vertical attacking buildup rather than patient possession retention
One of the weakest teams in the league at retaining possession under opposition pressure -- a real vulnerability, not just an attacking choice
Highest foul count in the league both recent seasons -- a side effect of the aggressive press
Progressive year-on-year improvement: 12th (48pts) -> 9th (56pts) -> 6th (57pts, first European qualification in club history)
High-risk, high-reward: centre-backs instructed to aggressively mark dropping forwards, leaving space in behind
